summary: KKR FS Income Trust Select filed a Form 8-K on October 5, 2026, reporting under Item 8.01 that its Board of Trustees declared a regular monthly dividend of $0.175 per common share, payable on or about November 25, 2026 to holders of record as of the close of business on October 30, 2026. Shareholders may elect cash or reinvestment in shares under the company's distribution reinvestment plan. No advisor, premium, stake, or structural transaction terms were disclosed. This is a routine dividend declaration, not a special situation; watch for any future NAV or distribution-rate changes.
